concepts.title: 호텔 복도 끝에서 걸어오는 워킹
concepts.background: 햇살이 들어오는 조용한 호텔 복도, 같은 자리에서 복도 끝을 보는 구도
concepts.background_en: A long, quiet hotel corridor in warm late-afternoon light, pale beige walls, a plain runner carpet in soft greige, tall windows far at the end of the corridor, no people, no signs, no text. The corridor runs straight away from the camera.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 복도 정면에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 카메라 고정, 줌·흔들림 없음
concepts.light: 오후 늦은 햇살, 따뜻하고 부드러운 빛, 크림빛 벽
concepts.why: 블랙·그레이 위주의 벌이라 밝은 베이지 복도에서 실루엣이 또렷하고, 정면으로 걸어와 전신과 포인트 아이템이 한눈에 보임
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level, about 8 meters from the spot where she stops, locked off on a tripod, no zoom, no shake, no push-in.
concepts.pace_en: Steady, confident runway-like walk toward the camera, a natural medium stride, about two steps per second, arms swinging lightly, shoulders level, no bouncing or waddling.
concepts.light_en: Soft warm late-afternoon sunlight from the windows at the end of the corridor, gentle shadows on the floor, consistent throughout.
concepts.direction_en: She walks from the far end of the corridor straight toward the camera, then exits to the right of frame near the camera.

shots.action: 복도 끝에서 정면으로 걸어와 가운데서 멈춘 뒤 오른쪽으로 퇴장, 퇴장하면 다음 벌이 복도 끝에서 등장
shots.pose: 가운데서 멈춰 어깨 너머로 가방끈을 한 번 고쳐 메고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands. 0-3s: she walks straight toward the camera with a medium stride, about two steps per second, growing gradually larger. 3-4s: she stops at the center, full body about 60% of the frame height, feet together, facing the camera. 4-5s: with her right hand she lifts the shoulder bag strap slightly and settles it back on her shoulder, then looks at the camera. 5-5.5s: she turns to her right and walks out of the frame to the right. Her blouse stays as shown, nothing is opened.
shots.start: 복도 끝 가운데에 작게 서서 걷기 시작, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 30%, 오른발이 앞, 팔은 자연스럽게 내림, 포즈는 아직 없음
shots.start_en: She is small in the center of the frame at the far end of the corridor, full body about 30% of the frame height, already mid-stride with the right foot forward, arms relaxed at her sides. She is not doing any pose yet.

shots.action: 복도 끝에서 정면으로 걸어와 가운데서 멈춘 뒤 오른쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 가운데서 멈춰 한 손으로 재킷 밑단을 가볍게 내려 정리하고 카메라 보기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her steps and hands. 0-2.5s: she walks straight toward the camera with a medium stride, about two steps per second. 2.5-3.5s: she stops at the center, full body about 60% of the frame height, facing the camera. 3.5-4.5s: with both hands she smooths the hem of the closed cropped jacket downward once, then looks at the camera. 4.5-5s: she turns to her right and walks out of the frame to the right. The jacket stays buttoned as shown.

concepts.title: 골목 코너를 돌아 나오는 오후
concepts.background: 해가 비스듬히 드는 파스텔 톤 유럽풍 골목 코너, 같은 모퉁이 자리
concepts.background_en: A quiet European-style street corner in the afternoon, smooth pale cream plaster walls with no signs and no text, light stone pavement, a plain wall corner on the left side of the frame where the street turns, no people, no cars. The street continues straight to the right behind the corner.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 모퉁이에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 카메라 고정, 줌·흔들림 없음
concepts.light: 오후 3시쯤 비스듬한 햇살, 따뜻한 그림자, 크림빛 벽
concepts.why: 무채색 벌이 많아 크림빛 벽과 밝은 돌바닥에서 또렷하게 보이고, 코너를 돌아 나오는 동선이 벌 바뀜을 자연스럽게 이음
concepts.pace: 보폭 보통, 1초에 약 2걸음, 코너를 돌아 나와 가운데서 멈춤
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level, about 7 meters from the spot where she stops, locked off, no zoom, no shake.
concepts.pace_en: Relaxed, natural stride, about two steps per second, arms swinging gently, shoulders level, no bouncing.
concepts.light_en: Warm slanted mid-afternoon sunlight from the right, soft shadows on the pavement, consistent throughout.
concepts.direction_en: She appears from behind the wall corner on the left edge of the frame, walks diagonally toward the center, stops, then walks away to the right.

concepts.title: 통유리 앞에서 가볍게 리듬 타기
concepts.background: 해 질 녘 빈 라운지의 큰 통창 앞, 같은 자리
concepts.background_en: An empty modern lounge at dusk, a large floor-to-ceiling window showing a soft blurred pink-orange sky and distant city lights, smooth light oak floor, plain pale walls, no furniture clutter, no people, no signs, no text. The window is straight behind the spot where she stands.
concepts.framing: 세로 9:16, 눈높이, 정면에서 조금 떨어진 거리, 카메라 고정, 줌·흔들림 없음
concepts.light: 해 질 녘 분홍빛 주황빛 노을, 부드러운 역광 느낌에 따뜻한 실내등
concepts.why: 걷기·복도와 다른 제자리 춤 동작이라 후보 차이가 크고, 노을빛 창 앞에서 검은 벌의 실루엣과 치맛자락이 잘 살아남
concepts.pace: 제자리에서 1초에 약 2번 가볍게 리듬, 발은 크게 움직이지 않음
concepts.camera_en: Fixed camera at eye level, about 7 meters in front of her, locked off, no zoom, no shake, no push-in.
concepts.pace_en: Light, easy dance in place at a relaxed tempo, about two gentle bounces per second, small weight shifts from foot to foot, feet staying roughly in the same spot, shoulders loose.
concepts.light_en: Warm dusk light from the window behind her softly rim-lighting her, gentle warm indoor fill on her front so her face and clothes stay clearly visible.
concepts.direction_en: She stays at the center in front of the window, facing the camera, and finishes by stepping out to the left.

shots.action: 화면 가운데 창 앞에 서서 어깨를 들썩이며 리듬 타다 한 바퀴 돌고 왼쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 제자리 한 바퀴 돌며 긴 치마 자락 보이기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her movements. 0-2s: she starts a light rhythm in place, about two gentle bounces per second, shifting her weight from foot to foot with loose shoulders and arms swinging slightly. 2-3.8s: she rolls her shoulders up and down to the beat, smiling at the camera. 3.8-5s: she makes one slow full turn on the spot so the long skirt swings gently, then faces the camera. 5-5.5s: she steps out of the frame to the left.
shots.start: 화면 가운데 창 앞에 서 있음, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 60%, 두 발은 어깨너비, 팔은 자연스럽게 내림, 춤은 아직 시작 전
shots.start_en: She stands at the center of the frame in front of the window, full body about 60% of the frame height, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing the camera. She has not started dancing yet.

shots.action: 창 앞에서 리듬 타다 팔을 가볍게 흔들고 왼쪽으로 퇴장

shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts. There is no wind: hair and clothes move only with her movements. 0-2s: she starts a light rhythm in place, about two gentle bounces per second, shifting her weight from foot to foot. 2-3.5s: she sways her arms lightly side to side to the beat. 3.5-4.5s: with her right hand she taps the hem of the closed cropped jacket once and lets go, shoulders bouncing, looking at the camera. 4.5-5s: she steps out of the frame to the left. The jacket stays buttoned as shown.
shots.start: 화면 가운데 창 앞에 서 있음, 전신이 화면 세로의 약 60%, 두 발은 어깨너비, 팔은 자연스럽게 내림, 춤은 아직 시작 전
shots.start_en: She stands at the center of the frame in front of the window, full body about 60% of the frame height, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at her sides, facing the camera. She has not started dancing yet.

shots.action: 창 앞에서 리듬 타다 가볍게 돌고 왼쪽으로 퇴장
shots.pose: 손끝으로 목 리본을 살짝 잡고 고개를 갸웃하며 웃기
shots.motion_en: One continuous take: no cuts, no scene changes, no close-up inserts.
